diagnostics.message: The dispatcher Lambda can be configured with VPC networking, but its VPC execution-role policy attachment is not ordered before function creation. Ensure the attachment exists before AWS configures the function's VPC access.

When VPC networking is configured, Lambda requires the VPC execution policy to be attached before function creation/configuration. The dispatcher function has no dependency on its conditional VPC execution-role attachment.

When VPC networking is configured, Lambda requires the VPC execution policy to be attached before function creation/configuration. The webhook function has no dependency on its conditional VPC execution-role attachment.

EventBridge requires a resource-based Lambda permission to invoke this target. The event target can be installed before that permission exists, leaving a window where matched events cannot invoke the dispatcher; make the target wait for the permission.
